# Pending Entity Handling

If there is a failure in the embedding provider, entities are marked as pending but the status handling may lead to inconsistencies if not properly addressed afterward. The search functionality may degrade to FTS without updated embeddings.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/retrieval/embed.py` — `knowledge_compiler.retrieval.embed.emit_embeddings`
